title: WhisperAI Configuration
description: JSON schema for the primary WhisperAI config.json

hotkey.description: The global keyboard shortcut used to toggle dictation (e.g., '<ctrl>+<alt>+w').

vad_threshold.description: Voice Activity Detection confidence threshold [0.0 - 1.0]. Higher is stricter.

model_selection.description: The Faster-Whisper model size to load (e.g., 'tiny', 'base', 'small', 'medium').

dictionary.description: List of custom vocabulary words to bias the ASR engine towards recognizing.

snippets.description: Key-value pairs for voice macros. Keys are spoken triggers, values are the injected text.

whisper_mode.description: If true, optimizes acoustic parameters for hushed speaking.

whisper_vad_threshold.description: Secondary VAD threshold when whisper_mode is active.

whisper_trim_db.description: Decibel threshold for silence trimming before inference.

whisper_rms_min.description: Minimum Root Mean Square (RMS) audio energy required to trigger transcription.
